europe_now.title: Berlin mayor says city is being blackmailed by hackers
europe_now.summary: Berlin's mayor has stated that the city is currently under a cyber blackmail attempt, though specific details about the attackers or demands remain undisclosed. The situation is being treated as a serious security threat, with authorities investigating the source and scope of the intrusion.

europe_now.title: Violence erupts in Ceuta amid ongoing migrant crisis
europe_now.summary: Clashes have broken out in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta as tensions rise over migration pressures, with protesters and police engaging in confrontations. The Spanish government has called for calm while security forces attempt to restore order amid broader regional migration challenges.

top_stories.title: Norway begins royal transition after King Harald V's death
top_stories.summary: Norway has commenced the formal process of transitioning its monarchy following the death of King Harald V, with Crown Prince Haakon set to ascend the throne. The royal family and government have announced a period of national mourning, and state ceremonies are being organized to mark the occasion.

top_stories.title: EU urges Meta to extend US teen safety rules to European platforms
top_stories.summary: European Union officials are pressing Meta to apply the same teen safety regulations used in the United States to its services operating in Europe, citing concerns over youth exposure to harmful content. The request reflects growing EU scrutiny of tech platforms' handling of child protection measures.
